Irene Park: Quick flag: on very narrow viewports (~300px) when the left rail auto-collapses, the main table gains a horizontal scroll and keyboard focus jumps off the selected row. Seen on iPhone SE and narrow Chrome emulation. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.internal/ux/issue-598.png

Ben Torres: Repro'd. Caused by the toolbar wrapping and increasing container height then the table width recalculates. Also saw long token strings pushing columns.

Molly Chen: Accessibility note: TalkBack reads truncated cells as just 'more' which is useless. We should expose the full text via aria-label and keep a separate visual truncation.

Akash Verma: Two small fixes: 1) clamp() first-column width + text-overflow: ellipsis; 2) make toolbar position: sticky so wrapping doesn't change the document flow. Minimal JS: after toggle call focusedCell.scrollIntoView({block: 'nearest'}).

Irene Park: Prefer CSS-first. Also prefer an inline copy icon in the first column instead of a "Show more" link. Users copy IDs 75% of the time.

Ben Torres: CSS POC I'll try on staging: 
```css
.row-id { min-width: 96px; max-width: clamp(80px, 28vw, 160px); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.toolbar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; }
@media (max-width: 360px) { .action-label { display: none; } }
```

Molly Chen: For a11y: aria-label="Full ID: 0xABC... (copy)" on the copy button; announce copy to an aria-live region. Keep focus styles visible and don't remove transitions for users who prefer reduced motion.

A11y-Bot: Tagging for full a11y review. Checklist: aria-labels, keyboard nav in overflow menu, focus management, screen reader text.

Akash Verma: I'll land a tiny change on feature/compact-ids: CSS clamp + sticky toolbar + copy button. Will include visual diffs at 320px and 280px and a small integration test asserting no horizontal scroll on 320px.

CI-Bot: Build 402 deployed to staging-ux (https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/402) :rocket:

Irene Park: Assigning @Akash for PR, @Molly for a11y, and @Ben for visual sign-off. Goal: canary tomorrow if tests pass. Thanks!
